subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder, blade pointing back
description: a heavy death: he is struck, staggers, drops to one knee, the greatsword slips from his hand and falls to the ground in front of him, then he collapses forward onto the ground and lies still; the last frames show him lying motionless. Side view facing right in every frame. No effects, no swoosh, no dust, no smoke, no motion trails.
